About this item

  • SUPER-HIGH HOLLYWOOD WAIST: Designed with a 12-inch super-high rise and a specialized "Hollywood" waistband that hugs your natural waist with completely clean lines. Tailored darts at the back waist eliminate gap, creating a smooth, flat, and highly flattering fit before even adding a belt.
  • MODERN STRAIGHT SILHOUETTE: Offers a perfectly balanced cut that is fitted through the waist and hips, slightly relaxed through the thighs, and finishes with a classic straight leg. The sleek 20-inch leg opening creates a clean, full-length drape that instantly lengthens your frame.
  • ELEVATED CITY STRETCH MOVEMENT: Crafted using Banana Republic’s beloved City Stretch design, offering a beautifully dressed-up appearance alongside incredible multi-directional stretch. Enjoy a structured look that "holds you in" comfortably through flights, long office hours, or dinner.
  • STREAMLINED STORAGE DETAILS: Meticulously detailed with a clean zip fly, a secure hook-and-bar closure, and functional front and back pockets that lay completely flat. The unlined, mid-weight construction provides breathable, zero-bulk comfort that layers smoothly over undergarments.
  • WORK-TO-WEEKEND CHAMELEON: A true foundational capsule piece built for maximum wearability. Effortlessly look chic by pairing these straight-leg trousers with a coordinating blazer and heels for a sharp professional look, or a tucked-in silk blouse and sleek sneakers for an upscale weekend vibe.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

Product Description

We love when a pant that looks as good as it feels, so we cut this high-rise straight pant in our City Stretch fabric—beloved for its softness, high-stretch and dressed-up appearance. Look closely: our designers chose a Hollywood waistband and darts at the back waist to create a high-rise with clean lines.
